correctness.rationale: For two states, reversible transitions have switch function e:X→C2; invertible outputs are a,b∈S_k. Inverse reversibility is exactly e(a^{-1}y)=e(b^{-1}y), equivalent to h=a^{-1}b preserving the color classes. This yields (k+1)(k!)² labelled machines. Fixed points of alphabet tau with no state swap are centralizers and invariant cycle colorings. With swap, a must commute with tau²; odd tau cycles remain one tau²-cycle and even tau cycles split into two, leading to N_j and c_{j,r} coefficients as stated. Burnside for S_k×C2 yields all-k partition formula, no hidden odd-order restriction. Independently exhaustively canonicalized labelled automata for k=1..4 under both symmetries: 2,8,28,124 orbit classes.
